title: Campaign answer (WebAir task sets)
description: The one structured answer every side's WebAir turn is scored on (PROTOCOL.md §2.3, rule 4): our side's result.json mapped field by field (score.from_webair_result), the framework agent's output_type, the browser agent's final JSON object. The status values are WebAir 0.8.0's own (agents/webair/schemas/status.schema.json).
